import sys

def get_io_stream(name: str):
    if name == 'stdin':
        return sys.stdin.buffer
    elif name == 'stdout':
        return sys.stdout.buffer
    elif name == 'stderr':
        return sys.stderr.buffer
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown stream name: {name}")

# Test cases
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import io
    import unittest

    class TestIOStream(unittest.TestCase):
        def test_stdin(self):
            with io.BytesIO(b'test input') as stdin_mock:
                old_stdin = sys.stdin
                sys.stdin = stdin_mock
                self.assertEqual(get_io_stream('stdin').read(), b'test input')
                sys.stdin = old_stdin

        def test_stdout(self):
            output = io.BytesIO()
            old_stdout = sys.stdout
            sys.stdout = output
            get_io_stream('stdout').write(b'test output\n')
            sys.stdout = old_stdout
            self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), b'test output\n')

        def test_stderr(self):
            error_output = io.BytesIO()
            old_stderr = sys.stderr
            sys.stderr = error_output
            get_io_stream('stderr').write(b'test error\n')
            sys.stderr = old_stderr
            self.assertEqual(error_output.getvalue(), b'test error\n')

    unittest.main()
```
